title: Listings Editor Reference — Minimum-Night Range and Instant Book
content:
# Listings Editor Reference: Minimum-Night Range and Instant Book

For each space type of Roamhaven Listings, the listing editor offers a minimum-night setting within a fixed range and an Instant Book switch.

| Space type | Lowest minimum-night setting (minimum-night floor) | Highest minimum-night setting (minimum-night ceiling) | Instant Book may be switched on |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shared Room | 1 night | 365 nights | yes |
| Private Room | 1 night | 365 nights | yes |
| Entire Guest Suite | 1 night | 365 nights | yes |
| Entire Apartment | 1 night | 365 nights | yes |
| Entire Home | 1 night | 365 nights | yes |
| Luxury Villa | 2 nights | 365 nights | yes |

**Minimum-night floor** is the lowest minimum-night setting the host may choose for the space type, and **minimum-night ceiling** the highest. Both are whole nights.

## Reading examples (hypothetical settings)

| Setting asked for | Space type | Within the range of the space type? |
|---|---|---|
| minimum stay of 1 night | Luxury Villa | no — the Luxury Villa floor is 2 nights |
| minimum stay of 1 night | Entire Apartment | yes |
| minimum stay of 365 nights | Entire Home | yes — equal to the ceiling |
| minimum stay of 366 nights | Shared Room | no — above the ceiling of 365 nights |
| Instant Book on | any space type | the switch may be turned on |
